name: nowhat
description: noWhat: for when you open a project and think… now what? A sidebar that shows where a project stands, what's next and what waits on you, worked out from the code, git, tests and live config

run_tests.title: Run test suites
run_tests.description: Let noWhat run the project's own test commands during setup to prove which features work

check_hosts.title: Check hosts by default (network)
check_hosts.description: For projects where you haven't answered noWhat's question: let it reach the network (your deploy host's CLI for env var names, never values; the launch checklist's requests; your deployed app; GitHub milestones). Off by default. Each project's own answer wins, and you can switch it in the sidebar
